title: Untracked parts sort below tracked ones by Total Quantity, both ways
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. A mix of tracked parts (various quantities, some tied) and untracked parts.
custom_steps:
1. Sort by the Total Quantity column ascending; note where untracked parts sit and the order of tracked parts.
  2. Sort descending; confirm untracked stay below tracked.
  3. Check tie-breaking within each group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Total Quantity column can be sorted; untracked parts sit below every tracked part in both directions, while tracked parts sort against each other by quantity.
  • Within the tracked group, parts holding the same quantity are ordered by part name A-Z; within the untracked group parts are ordered by part name A-Z.
